api_version: ECA&D daily nonblended observational station scope; MeteoGate 2026 route claimed but endpoint/path must be independently verified

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only, no automatic source request or caller-selected path, unbounded domain, secrets, crawler, bulk extraction or retries. Metadata path(s) are only candidate exact origins; actual provider GET requires independently reviewed provider machine-use terms, exact URL, byte cap, body hash and source-specific approved workflow.

response_contract.format: Provider policy and public station catalogue only. This contract deliberately does not contain a data-query endpoint or permission to download non-downloadable stations.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Daily station series include variable availability and optional gust fields; daily extrema are not equivalent to hourly or 3-second gust footprint. Nonblended and blended station observations must remain separate, and underlying provider source restrictions persist.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Provider restrictions apply; no API data retrieval or bulk download under this contract. Catalogue policy inspection only.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Individual stations may be non-downloadable or reassigned; restrictions apply at observation provenance and source time-series levels.

rights_and_policy.notes: The ECA&D/E-OBS provider data policy restricts observed station data to noncommercial research/education, including upstream station-use restrictions and non-downloadable records. There is no commercial insurance CAT calibration authorisation. An announced API does not override these source terms. Seek explicit product-use permission before any commercial scenario.

notes: Not to automate or stage as commercial model inputs. No original MeteoGate response, authenticated client, licensed derivative data, or validated station sample. The MeteoGate endpoint itself is not yet pinned as an official exact URL.
